## Distance to Alan's limits

Compare against the same yardsticks every time:

- the Landauer bound at the operating temperature, $k_B T \ln 2$ per erased bit;
- the Margolus-Levitin bound on operations per second for the energy involved;
- the Bekenstein bound on bits for the mass and size involved;
- the energy at the wall plug, with cooling and power delivery included.
